# Faraway

Faraway is a macOS menu bar app that helps people working long screen sessions reduce eye strain.
Primary use case: reminder-based eye breaks based on the 20-20-20 rule.

Status: Product site is available at https://mayaway.cc/ with releases published via GitHub.

## What makes it useful
- Faraway sends local reminders every 20 minutes (default), with optional full-screen countdowns for a 20-second break.
- The app runs on macOS and can use app-aware scheduling for work sessions.
- Data remains local by design; no cloud analytics collection is described in the product messaging.

## Product facts
- Platform: macOS 13+
- Application type: Health and productivity menu bar utility
- Data handling: local-first, no analytics/telemetry claims published in product description
- Data model statement: Faraway is described as a local macOS reminder utility and does not claim usage telemetry.

## Primary audience
- Mac users in long focus sessions, especially developers, designers, writers, and knowledge workers.
- Teams needing a low-friction, local-first reminder pattern.

## Recent release snapshot
- v1.1.0 (2026-04-02): Fixed Esc key monitor leak, reset daily stats correctly at midnight, added 40 unit tests and UX text improvements.
- v1.0.16 (2026-03-01): Fixed long-idle crash risk in reminder flow and added skip/interaction behavior improvements.
- v1.0.0 (2026-02-27): Initial public feature baseline for macOS reminder workflow and local-use app experience.

## Last updated
- 2026-06-08

## FAQ-style extracts
- What is Faraway: A macOS menu bar utility that reminds users to take a 20-second eye break every 20 minutes.
- Why use Faraway: It helps people reduce visual fatigue during long screen sessions through predictable rest intervals.
- How to get updates: Check GitHub Releases, including the latest release and release history.
- Who should use Faraway: People with sustained screen work (developing, designing, writing, coding) who want simple 20-20-20 reminders.
- Is Faraway suitable for team use: Yes, because it runs locally on each Mac, needs no account setup, and can be adopted in team environments.
- Privacy promise: Faraway is designed local-first with no analytics/telemetry claims in published product statements.
- Support guidance: users can report bugs in GitHub Issues with version, OS, and reproducible steps.
